disclaimerBlock.title: Disclaimer & Legal Notice
disclaimerBlock.subtitle: This is a public health data visualization platform, not a clinical or medical service.
disclaimerBlock.p1: This platform presents aggregate statistical estimates derived from peer-reviewed, publicly available epidemiological datasets. All figures are population-level estimates and not individual clinical diagnoses. No Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or Protected Health Information (PHI) is collected or stored.
disclaimerBlock.p2: This platform does not provide medical advice. If you or a loved one are experiencing cognitive symptoms, please consult a qualified neurologist or geriatrician immediately.
disclaimerBlock.p3: Directory records for memory clinics and NGOs are indexed for reference only. Inclusion does not constitute clinical endorsement. Please verify services independently before visiting.
disclaimerBlock.p4: No personal tracking or advertising cookies are utilized. The platform code is open source under the MIT License.
